title: Live model catalog at startup: routing picker shows fetched models, provider availability and balance

AC1.note: provider-catalog.ts buildCatalogEntry/refreshProviderCatalogFromDetected: parallel Promise.all fetch of fetchOpenAiCompatModelsDetailed+fetchProviderBalance, CATALOG_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS=8000, per-provider status via classifyModelsStatus (ok/auth-failed/unreachable/timeout/not-supported), fetchedAt recorded, unconnected providers excluded before probing. Unit tests in provider-catalog.test.ts cover a 401 (auth-failed) and a hanging fake provider (timeout) via injected fetch, no real wait.

AC2.note: tui-shell.ts launchTuiAgentShell: startupIndicator.setStep('checking providers…') during loading; providerCatalogReady = loadOrRefreshProviderCatalogFromDetected(...).catch(...) captured as a promise, never awaited inline before composer mounts, so a hung provider cannot block the first prompt. Verified by provider-catalog-startup.test.ts (source-text audit: spinner step + non-awaited const) plus provider-catalog.test.ts's injected hanging-fetch unit test for the actual bound.

AC3.note: provider-catalog-cache.ts: on-disk cache at provider-catalog.json in the user config dir, writeOwnerOnlyFileAtomic (mode 0600), CATALOG_CACHE_TTL_MS=5min, isCatalogFresh gates loadOrRefreshProviderCatalog(FromDetected). sanitizeEntry strips any non-shape/credential field on load. updateProviderCatalogEntry (used by 'providers test') takes the same withFileLock as a full refresh's save, merging into current on-disk entries rather than clobbering — fixes the round-1 lost-update race (commit message: 'the full refresh takes the catalog lock and keeps a newer on-disk entry'). Covered by provider-catalog-cache.test.ts incl. mode-0600 test and the merge-wins-over-older-entry test; providers.status.test.ts's 'providers test also updates the SAME catalog cache' test.

AC4.note: catalogToFlatPickerProviders (provider-catalog.ts): status ok -> live models; auth-failed -> excluded outright; unreachable/timeout/not-supported -> fallbackModels marked offline (rendered '(offline list)' by flatModelOptions). routing-inspector.ts defaultProviders() now reads loadOrRefreshProviderCatalog+catalogToFlatPickerProviders instead of detectProviders()'s curated lists (replaces the old root cause noted in the module header). /model unaffected (separate picker, not touched). Verified in provider-catalog.test.ts's catalogToFlatPickerProviders tests and the AC4/AC8 revert-check test.

AC5.note: commands/providers.ts: OpenRouter balancePath fixed from doubled '/api/v1/credits' (404, wrong shape) to '/v1/key' (limit_remaining) falling back to '/v1/credits' for an unlimited key (round-1 major fix, commit: 'OpenRouter balance used a doubled /api path and a response shape neither endpoint returns'). DeepSeek GET /user/balance already documented/used. fetchProviderBalance is timeout-bounded (BALANCE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS via AbortController) and its response body is now size-capped (round-1 minor fix: 'balance bodies are size-capped'). API key never logged/cached: provider-catalog-cache.ts's ProviderCatalogEntry type and sanitizeEntry never carry a credential field. Verified live: env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY bun src/cli.ts providers status --refresh showed openrouter balance $9.99 and deepseek balance $6.41 (see AC9). Unit-tested per provider in providers.balance.test.ts.

AC6.note: tui-shell.ts: providerCatalogReady.then((catalog) => { if (destroyed) return; ... }) announces a non-blocking startup notice once per failing provider (auth-failed/unreachable/timeout) via announceStartupNotice, English text 'name: status — /connect to fix'. The destroyed-shell guard was added in round 1 (commit: 'the startup notice checks for a destroyed shell') fixing the minor finding about a use-after-teardown paint. /connect row list and connected-provider step show catalog status/balance/age via describeCatalogStatus/formatCatalogAge (connect-provider-buttons.test.ts). Verified by provider-catalog-startup.test.ts's AC6 test asserting auth-failed/timeout notice text.

AC7.note: commands/providers.ts: 'keryx providers status [--json] [--refresh]' implemented (runProvidersStatus), printing per connected provider status/model count/balance/fetchedAt; --refresh forces loadOrRefreshProviderCatalog(force:true). Registered in HELP_GROUPS (src/standard/help-groups.ts summary updated) and docs/docs/cli-reference.md (status row + 'Live provider catalog' section added); docs/docs/commands-by-task.md regenerated (+1/-1 in commit). Unit-tested in providers.status.test.ts (json+human output, --refresh, fake provider excluded, providers test updates same cache).

AC8.note: All new/changed tests (provider-catalog.test.ts, provider-catalog-cache.test.ts, providers.status.test.ts, providers.balance.test.ts, connect-provider-buttons.test.ts, provider-catalog-startup.test.ts) use injected fetch/deps, no real network calls or real timers (timeoutMs test seam avoids the real 8s wait). provider-catalog.ts is explicitly documented as client zone ('no TUI import — testable and usable without a renderer'), mirrors routing/table.ts's existing no-TUI-deps posture, importing only commands/select, commands/providers and provider-catalog-cache (no client-only modules imported from core). AC4/AC8 revert-check test in provider-catalog.test.ts (line ~250) asserts the picker excludes an unconnected compat provider that the OLD detectProviders()-sourced picker always included, proving the old hardcoded source would fail this test.

AC10.note: CI on PR #712 (https://github.com/MrCipherSmith/keryx/pull/712, merged as 7abc0fb0bbb5c0b91dc930e6ca0f05295eecdc5b): 19 status checks, 18 SUCCESS + 1 SKIPPED (deploy to GitHub Pages, not applicable to a PR build), 0 failing — confirmed via gh pr view 712 --json statusCheckRollup. keryx health run in this worktree: PASS, project score 94, no gate conditions triggered. docs/docs/cli-reference.md updated (status subcommand row + 'Live provider catalog' section); docs/docs/commands-by-task.md regenerated.

AC9.note: Re-ran: env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY bun src/cli.ts providers status --refresh in this worktree (operator's real connected providers, no key printed). Result: 9 connected providers all status=ok — deepseek (2 models, balance $6.41), github-copilot (42 models), grok (13 models), groq (11 models), MiniMax (8 models), ollama (7 models), openrouter (460 models, balance $9.99), zai (11 models), zai-coding (11 models). Matches the fixer's prior run (9 connected ok; OpenRouter 460 models/$9.99 of a $10 key limit; DeepSeek balance ~$6.4x) within normal balance drift between runs. The synthetic 'fake' provider does not appear in the catalog (excluded per round-1 fix). /routing's flat picker reads this same catalog via catalogToFlatPickerProviders (AC4).
